question: To remain healthy and disease free, taking a balanced diet is very important. A balanced diet is:

options.text: a diet that contains adequate amount of protein and fat
a diet that contains appreciable number of vitamins and minerals
a diet that contains sufficient amount of all the nutrients that the human body needs to grow properly
a diet that contains adequate amount of carbohydrates

solution:
The Correct answer is __**a diet that contains sufficient amount of all the nutrients that the human body needs to grow properly**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **balanced diet** is essential for maintaining overall health and well-being by ensuring the body receives all the **necessary nutrients**.
 
• It comprises appropriate proportions of **macronutrients** such as **carbohydrates, proteins, and fats**, along with **micronutrients** like **vitamins and minerals**.
